Ekartman Rehberi.title: Size Guide
Ekartman Rehberi.html:
On every model page you will see three numbers in the form 51 □ 18 – 145. This is the frame size and lets you estimate in advance whether a frame will fit your face.

What do the three numbers mean?

MeasureWhere?Typical rangeWhat it affects
Lens widthWidest horizontal span of one lens46–58 mmHow much of the face the frame covers; the "big/small" look
BridgeDistance between the two lenses14–22 mmHow it sits on the nose; a narrow bridge won't slide on narrow noses
Temple lengthFrom the hinge to the temple tip135–150 mmGrip behind the ear; too short pinches, too long slips

How to find your own size

Look at the inside of the left temple of the glasses you wear comfortably now. The model code, colour code and size are printed there (e.g. LC1408.C1 51□19-140). Those three numbers are your reference:

  • Differences of ±2 mm in lens width, ±1 mm in bridge and ±5 mm in temple length are usually not noticeable.
  • A quick estimate of total width: 2 × lens width + bridge. For 51□19 that is about 121 mm. It should be close to the width of your face.
  • With strong prescriptions (±4 and above) a smaller lens width and a frame that centres on the eye keep the lenses thinner.

Model and colour codes

In the catalogues each model has a code (e.g. Q503) and the colour variant is written separately (Q503.C2). Search the model code on this site and you will see every colour on one page. Searching the colour code (C2) opens the same page with that colour selected.

Clip-on models

On clip-on models the size belongs to the optical frame; the magnetic sun clip is made to the same dimensions, so no extra measurement is needed.

Sizes are a first screening; make the final decision by trying the frame on at an authorised optician, who will personalise the fit with nose pad and temple adjustments.

Sık Sorulan Sorular.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Sık Sorulan Sorular.html:
About this site

Can I buy glasses from this site?

No. This site is the information catalogue of the Lee Cooper, Quantum, Slazenger and Belmond 2026 collections. Sales are made only through authorised opticians.

How do I find the model I'm looking for?

Type the model code into the search box in the top menu (e.g. LC1408 or 9599.C2). The code is printed on the inside of the temple. You can also browse the collections through the Brands menu and filters, or type a phrase such as "blue clip-on".

Why are there no prices?

Prices depend on the store and the lenses chosen. Please ask an authorised store for the recommended price.

About the products

What is the difference between an optical frame and a clip-on?

An optical frame is made for prescription lenses. Clip-on models additionally come with a polarized sun clip that attaches to the frame magnetically, so one pair serves as both prescription glasses and sunglasses.

What do polarized lenses do?

They block the horizontal light reflected from roads, water and glass surfaces; glare drops and contrast improves. All clip-on lenses carry UV400 protection.

What is the blue-light (anti-glare night) option?

Some Slazenger clip-on models offer a yellow-tinted night-driving lens that softens oncoming headlight glare. It is shown with the "Blue-light option" badge on the model page.

How do I choose between frame materials?

  • Metal: slim, classic look; adjustable nose pads.
  • Acetate: vivid colours and patterns; warm to the touch, sturdy.
  • Titanium: the lightest and hypoallergenic option; for those with metal allergies.
  • TR90 / Ultem: flexible, unbreakable, very light; ideal for children and sport.

Will the size fit me?

Compare the size on each model page with your current glasses. See the size guide for details.

This notice explains, under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), which data of visitors to this catalogue site is processed, why and how. Last updated: October 2026.

Skyland İstanbul No:4 Skyflat A Blok Kat 7, Sarıyer / İstanbul · info@arikantime.com · +90 850 420 14 14. Other contact channels are on the Contact page.

WhatsApp linksInformation you send via WhatsAppAnswering your questions. Messaging runs on WhatsApp (Meta) infrastructure; Meta's own privacy policy applies.

For the site to work, your browser's local storage also holds favourites (ao_fav_v1), the request list (ao_order_v1, ao_dealer_info), the language preference (ao_lang) and a short-lived copy of the catalogue data; these contain no personal data and are not sent to us. You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings; the site keeps working.

Dealer request records are kept for as long as the commercial relationship and statutory limitation periods require. Analytics data is retained in Google Analytics for at most 14 months. Local data on your device stays in your browser until you delete it.

Güneş Gözlüğü Seçimi Nasıl Yapılır?.title: How to Choose Sunglasses
Güneş Gözlüğü Seçimi Nasıl Yapılır?.summary: UV protection, polarized lenses, lens colour and face shape: the five things to check when choosing the right sunglasses.
Güneş Gözlüğü Seçimi Nasıl Yapılır?.html:
Sunglasses are as much a protective device as an accessory. The right choice directly affects your eye health, driving safety and all-day comfort. Here is how an optician picks sunglasses, in five steps.

1. UV400 protection is a must

Dark lenses do not mean protection. A dark lens without a UV filter dilates the pupil and lets more ultraviolet light into the eye. Always look for the UV400 label (full protection up to 400 nanometres) and the CE mark. All branded sunglasses sold at authorised stores meet this standard.

2. When do you need polarized lenses?

Polarized lenses cut the horizontal light reflected from roads, water, snow and glass. They make a big difference for drivers, people who spend time by the sea or a lake, and anglers. Note: some car instruments and phone screens can look dark at certain angles through polarized lenses; pilots do not use them.

3. What does lens colour do?

ColourEffectBest for
Smoke / greyReduces brightness without altering coloursEveryday use, driving
BrownBoosts contrast and depth perceptionChanging light, outdoor sports
Green (G15)Balanced contrast, easy on the eyesLong wear
Yellow / orangeAdds contrast in low lightFog, night driving (anti-glare)
GradientDark at the top, light at the bottomReading the dashboard in the car

4. Frame by face shape

  • Round face: angular, rectangular frames lengthen the face.
  • Angular face: round and oval shapes soften the lines.
  • Oval face: almost any shape works; keep the frame no wider than the face.
  • Heart-shaped face: shapes fuller at the bottom, aviators and cat-eyes balance it.

5. Size and fit

The three numbers on the temple (e.g. 55 □ 16 – 145) give lens width, bridge and temple length. The frame should not touch the eyebrows or rest on the cheeks, and should not slide when you tilt your head forward. On metal models with nose pads, the optician can adjust the pads to your nose.

Tip: If you wear prescription lenses, clip-on models give you optical glasses and sunglasses in one frame. Browse the clip-on collection.

Yüz Şeklinize Göre Gözlük Çerçevesi Nası.title: How to Choose Frames for Your Face Shape
Yüz Şeklinize Göre Gözlük Çerçevesi Nası.summary: Round, square, oval or heart-shaped face: which frame shape balances it and which exaggerates it?
Yüz Şeklinize Göre Gözlük Çerçevesi Nası.html:
Glasses sit in the middle of the face; their shape and colour either harmonise with your features or clash with them. The basic rule is simple: the frame should complement the opposite of your face's lines.

How to tell your face shape

Stand in front of a mirror, pull your hair back and compare the width of your forehead, cheekbones and jawline. If forehead and chin are about equal and the face is long, you are oval; if width is close to length, round; if the jawline is strong and angular, square; if the forehead is wide and the chin narrow, heart-shaped.

Round face

Angular lines add definition. Rectangular, wayfarer and geometric shapes work well; avoid round and small frames. A dark upper line (browline) lifts the face.

Square face

Choose round, oval and aviator shapes to soften a strong jawline. Slim metal frames lighten the face; thick angular acetates make the lines even harder.

Oval face

The most flexible face type. To keep the balance, the frame should not be wider than the widest point of the face; very small frames make the face look bigger.

Heart-shaped face

With a wide top and narrow chin, shapes that are fuller at the bottom (the opposite of a cat-eye, round-bottomed models) and lighter colours restore balance. Very wide upper lines make the forehead look broader.

Colour and material

  • Warm skin tones suit brown, tortoise and gold; cool tones suit black, grey, silver and navy.
  • Acetate frames add character; metal and titanium look lighter and more understated.
  • Crystal (clear) colours give a modern look without tiring the face.

Don't forget the size

However right the shape, the wrong size is uncomfortable. Use the measurements on the temple of your current glasses as a reference and see the size guide. Every model page on this site lists lens, bridge and temple sizes.

Clip-On Gözlük Nedir, Kime Uygundur?.title: What Are Clip-On Glasses and Who Are They For?
Clip-On Gözlük Nedir, Kime Uygundur?.summary: One frame, two uses: the advantages of clip-on glasses with magnetic polarized lenses and what to watch out for.
Clip-On Gözlük Nedir, Kime Uygundur?.html:
Everyone who wears prescription glasses knows the problem: switching to sunglasses when stepping outside. Clip-on models solve it with a single frame; a polarized sun clip attaches magnetically to the front of the optical frame and comes on and off in seconds.

How does it work?

Hidden magnets sit in the bridge and at the ends of the frame. Because the clip is made from the same mould, it fits the frame exactly; it doesn't rattle and doesn't scratch the lenses. When removed it is thin enough to carry in its case or a pocket.

Advantages

  • One set of prescription lenses, two pairs of glasses: no cost for separate prescription sunglasses.
  • Polarized lenses cut glare; comfort for drivers.
  • Unlike photochromic (colour-changing) lenses, they also darken inside the car and need no transition time.
  • Ideal for progressive (multifocal) wearers: same lens, same habit.

Things to watch

  • The clip fits only its own frame; it cannot be swapped to another model.
  • With strong prescriptions and thick lenses the gap between clip and lens shrinks; ask your optician.
  • Polarized lenses can darken some LCD screens at certain angles.

Night-driving option

Some Slazenger clip-on models also offer a yellow-tinted night-driving lens that softens oncoming headlight glare. It is shown with the "Blue-light option" badge on the model page.

Gözlük Çerçevesi Malzemeleri: Metal, Ase.title: Frame Materials: Metal, Acetate, Titanium, TR90
Gözlük Çerçevesi Malzemeleri: Metal, Ase.summary: Weight, durability, allergies and looks: the differences between frame materials and which one suits you.
Gözlük Çerçevesi Malzemeleri: Metal, Ase.html:
The frame material determines its weight, durability, adjustability and how it sits on your face. Let's compare the four main materials in our catalogues.

Metal

Slim, classic and light. Adjustable nose pads adapt it to different nose shapes. Plating quality matters; on authorised products the finish is long-lasting. Anyone sensitive to nickel should prefer titanium or acetate.

Acetate

Plant-based cellulose acetate offers colour depth, patterns (tortoise, crystal, speckled) and character. Slightly heavier than metal but very sturdy. There are no nose pads, so the bridge size matters more.

Titanium

The lightest and most durable metal; corrosion-resistant and hypoallergenic. Ideal for all-day wearers and people with metal allergies. The Quantum collection includes titanium optical and clip-on models.

TR90 and Ultem

Flexible, break-resistant, feather-light thermoplastics. Suited to sport, children and heavy use; they bend but do not break. The Slazenger clip-on series uses Ultem, Lee Cooper has TR90 models.

Which one is for you?

NeedSuggestion
As light as possibleTitanium, TR90
Colour and characterAcetate
Metal allergyTitanium, acetate, TR90
Sport / childrenTR90, Ultem
Classic slim lookMetal, titanium

On the collection page you can filter models by material with the Frame material filter.
